summary_rationale: ABM Industries is a durable $8.75B FY2025 ($6.85B 9M FY2026) essential facility-services leader with a 58-year dividend-increase streak, raised FY2026 FCF guidance (~$210M), and growth verticals in Aviation, semiconductor cleanrooms (WGNSTAR), and microgrids/UPS (RavenVolt, Quality Uptime). However, our Pass 1 blind-spot audit flagged material conditionalities: 9M FY2026 margins compressed in ATS (-129 bps to 6.2%), M&D (-103 bps to 8.6%), and Aviation (-85 bps to 5.0%), prompting a segment margin guidance trim to 7.7%–7.8%; goodwill + intangibles reached $3.07B (-$1.28B tangible equity); ~86% of $1.78B gross debt is floating-rate post-June 2026 swap expiration ahead of a $1.68B FY29–30 maturity wall; net self-insurance reserves stand at $584.0M (with $43.6M adverse prior-year development in FY24–25); unbilled contract assets climbed to $518.9M; and executive LTI metrics lack an ROIC hurdle while excluding prior-year insurance reserve adjustments.
